user.title: ZTE access points
user.description: Addresses of the router and any mesh units, e.g. `http://192.168.1.1`. Logins are read from the Home Assistant container environment: `ZTE_USERNAME` and `ZTE_PASSWORD` for all units, or `ZTE_USERNAME_<host>` and `ZTE_PASSWORD_<host>` for one unit (e.g. `ZTE_PASSWORD_192_168_1_2`).

reconfigure.title: ZTE access points
reconfigure.description: Addresses of the router and any mesh units. Tracked devices stay as they are.

devices.title: Devices to track
devices.description: Each selected device is home while it is connected to the Wi-Fi of any of the access points.

error.no_urls: Enter at least one access point address.
error.invalid_url: Addresses must look like `http://192.168.1.1` (http or https, no login in the address).
error.missing_env: No login is set in the Home Assistant container for one of the access points.
error.invalid_auth: An access point rejected the login (or is locked after failed logins).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an access point or read its Wi-Fi client list.

abort.already_configured: ZTE Wi-Fi presence is already set up; change it under Configure.
abort.single_instance_allowed: ZTE Wi-Fi presence is already set up; change it under Configure.

error.missing_env: No login is set in the Home Assistant container for one of the access points.
error.invalid_auth: An access point rejected the login (or is locked after failed logins); its devices may be missing from the list.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an access point; its devices may be missing from the list.
